label: Hikvision DS-3E0505HP-E (4-port PoE with 60 W Hi-PoE)
description: Hikvision 4-port gigabit unmanaged PoE switch: 3x 1G PoE+ (30 W) + 1x 1G Hi-PoE (802.3bt, 60 W) plus 1x 1G uplink, 65 W total.
notes: Vendor figures from the DS-3E0505HP-E datasheet: **3 x gigabit PoE ports, 1 x gigabit Hi-PoE port and 1 x gigabit RJ45 uplink**, **port 1 is Hi-PoE: 802.3af/at/bt, 60 W max**; ports 2-4 are 802.3af/at, 30 W; total **65 W**. **The Hi-PoE port is the reason to buy it** - 60 W on port 1 runs a PTZ dome or a heated camera that 802.3at cannot start, and the 65 W total means running it at full draw leaves ~5 W for everything else.
